Wachtwoorden, codes en recovery codes ko: Passwords, codes and recovery codes never appear here. Not even shortened.
Wat deed je daar? Laat leeg als het niet: What did you do there? Leave it blank if it is not needed.
Wat er aan de inhoud van je website is v: What has changed in your website's content, by whom and when. You can filter by section and by action, so "show me what happened to the timeline" is a single click.
Wat je in het vierkantje ziet, is precie: What you see in the square is exactly what goes onto your website. We then turn it into one tidy image, so a five-megabyte file does not slow your page down.
Wat speelt er, wat is er al, en waar loo: What is going on, what is already there, and where it gets stuck.
We hebben je een link gestuurd. Klik daa: We have sent you a link. Click it to confirm your email address.
We reageren doorgaans binnen een werkdag: We usually reply within one working day.
Weet je zeker dat je de passkey \":naam\: Are you sure you want to delete the passkey ":naam"? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
Weet je zeker dat je het account van :na: Are you sure you want to delete the account for :naam? This cannot be undone.
Werkende software plus de documentatie o: Working software plus the documentation to carry on with it yourself.
Wij tellen er :aantal. Zet dit cijfer op: We count :aantal. Set this number to automatic and it will keep itself up to date.
Wij tellen er nu :aantal, en dat werkt v: We count :aantal right now, and that updates by itself.
Wij tellen het uit je tijdlijn, dus het: We count it from your timeline, so it stays correct by itself.
Wijs er eentje aan en er komt een gekleu: Point at one and a coloured disc appears beneath it, so you know exactly which of the two you have.
Wordt een lijst lang, dan komen er onder: When a list grows long, numbered pages appear at the bottom. Click a row to open that item's own page.
Zet eerst tweestapsverificatie aan. Deze: Turn on two-factor authentication first. This action requires an authenticator code.
Zet er een op dit apparaat en je logt vo: Add one on this device and from then on you sign in without a password.
Zet je hem uit, dan bewaren we hem wel m: Turn this off and we will keep it, but visitors will not see it. You can put it online later.
Zo staan ze achter elke regel in een tab: This is how they appear at the end of every table row.
Zoek op functie, organisatie of plaats: Search by role, organisation or place
Zoek op naam of e-mailadres: Search by name or email address
Zoek op onderwerp, type of ontvanger: Search by subject, type or recipient
Zolang dit leeg is, laten we het hele on: While this is empty, we leave the whole section off your website. Add your first experience and it will appear by itself.
Zolang dit uitstaat is je wachtwoord het: While this is off, your password is the only lock on this portal. Setting it up takes a minute and all you need is an authenticator app.
